pool.desc: Sends ghostly flames that home in and burn the target.

pool.name: Hex
pool.desc: A close-range grab that seizes the target. Power is 1.5x if the target has a status condition.

pool.name: Moonlight
pool.desc: Restores 30% of max HP. Works twice a battle (all its healing moves together).

pool.name: Shadow Sneak
pool.desc: Sinks into its own shadow, where it can't be hit, and rises out of the target's to strike.

pool.name: Curse
pool.desc: Raises Attack and Defense by 1 but lowers Speed by 1. Works twice per stay on the field.

pool.name: Confuse Ray
pool.desc: Sends ghostly orbs at the target's head: it staggers and becomes confused.

pool.name: Psychic
pool.desc: Grabs the target with telekinesis and flings it; a far-off or attacking target can break free. 10% chance: Sp. Def down.

pool.name: Dark Pulse
pool.desc: Fires waves of dark energy. The last wave has a 20% chance to make the target flinch (a brief stagger).

pool.name: Calm Mind
pool.desc: Raises Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by 1. Works twice per stay on the field.

pool.name: Protect
pool.desc: Raises a dome that blocks every attack while it stands. Waits 7 s, and 3 s longer after each use (back to 7 s on a switch).

pool.name: Substitute
pool.desc: Pays 1/4 of max HP to leave a decoy that takes hits until it breaks. Works once per battle.

pool.name: Quick Attack
pool.desc: Darts in so fast it leaves streaks of light, hitting from several sides.

pool.name: Swift
pool.desc: Fires a burst of star-shaped rays. Can't be dodged.
